_note: The real floor, in the Lighthouse frame of calibration.yaml (metres, yaw degrees CCW). Use it with ARENA=manager/arena.floor.json. FIELD: 5 m (x) by 3 m (y), assumed centred on the Lighthouse origin (which is inside the net): x -2.5..2.5, y -1.5..1.5. CHECK on the floor: put a Crazyflie in two opposite corners and read its pose; if the field is shifted or the long side runs along y, change bounds, drone_cage, zones and home here AND drone_server.py DEFAULT_CAGE (tests/test_integration.py keeps the two cages equal). drone_cage = bounds 0.3 m in from each wall. Zones, home, launch pad and overhead tags are provisional; measure them with the target Crazyflie as a wand and set calibrated:true. manager/arena.json stays the mock/test arena.
_view_note: view = what the dashboard map shows: the 5 x 3 m field plus a 0.4 m margin (the map also grows by itself if a robot or the pad is outside). launch_pad = where the scout sits before takeoff; the drone server reports the real one (its first takeoff spot) once it has flown. Measure it and fill it in.

overhead._note: PLACEHOLDER. Railing camera above one edge of the net, looking down at an angle. ArUco tags 0-3 (DICT_4X4_50) flat on the floor just outside the net corners; enter their measured centres. camera_floor_xy = the floor point straight below the lens (it may be outside the net), camera_height_m = lens height above the floor.

_cage_note: drone_cage measured 2026-10-11: largest x/y-aligned box inside the drone's Lighthouse reception corners (2.208,-0.683) (1.96,1.18 from 2026-10-10) (-2.551,1.195) (-1.633,-0.755); no inset. Same as drone_server.py DEFAULT_CAGE.
_zones_note: Zones fitted 2026-10-11 to the Lighthouse reception area (= drone_cage): with ROVER_RIDER=target the rover's position comes from the riding Crazyflie, so everything the rover drives to must be where Lighthouse reaches. disposal moved from the bottom-left corner (no reception there: the -x side of the reception area slants) to x -1.6..-0.9, y -0.68..0; field_a = x -0.8..0.6, field_b = x 0.6..1.96, both y -0.68..1.18. base holds the rover start (see _home_note). launch_pad = the scout's pad measured with the cage.
_plate_note: plate_offset is the docking plate (DOCK_MODE). The riding Crazyflie uses rider_mount.
_goto_note: rover_goto counts as arrived within goto_tolerance_m. It stops 0.6 m short of a drone finding (the camera must see it) unless the step sets standoff (0 = onto the spot, floor_mark_and_drive). The rover's position is the riding Crazyflie's Lighthouse pose minus plate_offset (ROVER_RIDER=target).

rover._note: EP footprint 30 x 24 cm. grip_reach_m = from the centre of the four wheels (what it turns about) to the middle of the OPEN jaws with the arm in pick: put the bottle between the jaws and measure it. rover_approach stops when the bottle's spot is there.

rider_mount._note: The riding Crazyflie (...04) in the ROVER frame (x forward, y left, metres) and its heading minus the rover's (deg). Estimate from the 2026-10-11 photo: back-right corner of the 30 x 24 cm rover. Run Manual control > 'Calibrate rider' once on the floor (25 cm forward, half a turn, back): it measures all three and keeps them in runs/rider_mount.json, which wins over this.

_home_note: home = the rover's start and where it brings our own drones: (-2.0, 0.45) in the base zone, 0.47 m from the scout's pad (-1.84, 0.92) so the rover never parks on it; inside Lighthouse reception (its -x edge is at x -2.2 for this y).
